# Joseph Doyle-Samadi — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Joseph Doyle-Samadi, a software engineer building
> full-stack web applications. Contact: contact@josephsamadi.uk.
> GitHub: https://github.com/icarus2419 ·
> LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/joseph-doyle-samadi-015566226/

Joseph builds reliable, interactive software with a focus on Python,
JavaScript/TypeScript, React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and WebSockets.

## Projects

- [Modular Multiplayer Poker Platform](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/poker-platform/):
  Python game engine with FastAPI-style routes, Redis-backed room state, and a
  polling-first browser client. Playable at https://josephsamadi.uk/poker/.
- [NoSite Leads Helper](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/nosite-leads/):
  Privacy-first Chrome Manifest V3 extension that finds businesses without
  websites on Google Maps, with a local lead manager and Stripe-backed Premium
  licensing.
- [SecureDoc Document Approval](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/securedoc-combined/):
  Role-based document approval workflow with SHA-256 evidence, approval
  receipts, and audit trails. Node.js/Express.

## Experience

- Freelance client website builds (Sep 2025–present).
- Software Engineer at Heaven Estate Agent (Dec 2024–Sep 2025): frontend
  modernization, SEO improvements, legacy booking system uplift.
